shortDescription: Add DNSSEC private key to a zone

options.name: algorithm
options.description: The algorithm to be used for signing

options.name: api_port
options.description: Port for the Technitium DNS API. Defaults to 5380

options.name: api_url
options.description: Base URL for the Technitium DNS API

options.name: curve
options.description: The name of the curve to be used when using ECDSA or EDDSA algorithm For ECDSA algorithm valid values are P256, P384 For EDDSA algorithm valid values are ED25519, ED448 This parameter is required when using ECDSA or EDDSA algorithm

options.name: hash_algorithm
options.description: The hash algorithm to be used when using RSA algorithm This parameter is required when using RSA algorithm

options.name: key_size
options.description: The size of the generated private key in bits to be used when using RSA algorithm This parameter is required when using RSA algorithm Common values are 2048, 3072, 4096

options.name: key_type
options.description: The type of key for which the private key is to be generated

options.name: node
options.description: The node domain name for which this API call is intended When unspecified, the current node is used This parameter can be used only when Clustering is initialized

options.name: pem_private_key
options.description: Specifies a user generated private key in PEM format to add When not specified a private key will be automatically generated Must match the specified algorithm and curve/key_size parameters

options.name: rollover_days
options.description: The frequency in days that the DNS server must automatically rollover the private key Valid range is 0-365 days where 0 disables rollover Default value is 90 days for Zone Signing Key (ZSK) and 0 days for Key Signing Key (KSK)

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when making API requests.

options.name: zone
options.description: The name of the primary zone to add the private key to
